verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents its own Explore mode for read-only codebase questions, plus an Explore subagent and project file search via `@`. Together these directly support asking how a codebase fits together. The evidence is only brief feature mentions, though, with no detail on how well it maps architecture or finds starting points for changes. Missing for 10: documentation of codebase-structure or architecture explanation, guidance on locating entry points for changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can understand how a codebase fits together to find where to start making changes

citations.quote: Switch to Explore mode for read-only codebase questions with minimal latency.
Mastra Code can search project files and attach a path to your message when you type `@` followed by part of a filename
